notes.title: Get Ready for Cat Museum at Steam's Lunar New Year Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers! Cat Museum is going to participate in Steam's Lunar New Year Sale! We're bringing the game to gamers around the world at an all-time low, so come join us for this audio-visual feast and get a great gaming experience at a great value!

Event Period: From 10:00, Jan. 26, 2025 to 10:00, Feb. 9, 2025 (PT)
Discount: 65% off

Cat Museum is a 2D side-scrolling adventure puzzle game with a unique and surreal fantasy art style. In the game, you will work together with the kitty to solve weird puzzles and unravel the layers of fog to unveil the truth of the deep-seated museum!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42060643/75744c89598973b4195898b5c946da8e4d513871.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Be dressed in new look to go on fantastic journeys with cats!
notes.notes:

Quickly put on the clothes of the same colors as the fellow cats. Go deep into the museum, crack the mechanisms and solve the puzzles!
